title: MiniMax H3 Seamless Loop Video
short_description: Generate short seamless-loop videos with native audio (first-last-frame I2V) on RunPod Serverless.
description: Image-to-video with MiniMax H3 FL2VA + turbo 8-step LoRA: the start image is used as both first and last frame, so the clip loops seamlessly on player repeat. Native stereo audio included. Returns the video as base64 MP4.
